covariance_phase_definitions.consequence: These are separately named dimensionless reporting views. Midnight maxima/counts can differ without a changed price, trade, account balance or covariance source.
covariance_phase_definitions.inherited_report: Original frozen annual_reporting.risk_diagnostics indexes decisions at close_us-1. Retained and exactly reproduced.
covariance_phase_definitions.monitor_completed_close: New monitor evaluates after completed close/full funding and sameclock daily binding; decision_us<=close_us. This additive view uses that clock, including new covariance at exact midnight.

existing_review_field_scope_clarificatio.actual_sigma_max: post-sameclock-decision covariance; may differ from nested frozen risk_report maximum
existing_review_field_scope_clarificatio.original_reporting_sigma_above_budget_pl: post-sameclock-decision covariance and hypothetical1e-12 threshold; this legacy field name does not mean the frozen annual report uses1e-12
existing_review_field_scope_clarificatio.risk_report.forecast_volatility_breach_m: frozen close-minus1us covariance and original1e-10 reporting tolerance

control_actual_minute_close_risk_report.capital_count_qualification: Compact rejected-corner reasons may combine gross/asset/vol/capital failures. No named capital reason does not imply no capital binding. Exposure shortfall is not capital-attributed.
control_actual_minute_close_risk_report.realized_volatility_formula: std(ddof1, complete daily NAV simple returns including initial10000)*sqrt365
